style: Japanese sports anime style, cel shading, bold clean linework, dramatic speed lines, vibrant colors, cinematic floodlit night stadium. <Picture 1> is LUCA SANCHEZ #7 (curly black hair, tan skin, brown eyes), <Picture 2> is TUCKER THOMPSON #11 (wavy brown hair, light skin), <Picture 3> is GRACEN ADAMS #8 (messy brown hair, captain armband). Use the pictures only for each player's face, hair and build; ignore the character-sheet layout and its text. All HHS players, including Luca and Tucker, wear the black HHS kit from <Picture 3>: black jersey with white numbers, black shorts, black socks. Each of the three appears at most once per shot; other HHS teammates are generic players with different numbers. Only Gracen #8 wears the captain armband. Bartlett players wear red kits with white trim.

acts.name: act1
acts.prompt:
CUT 1: sweeping aerial shot of a packed night stadium under blazing floodlights, the scoreboard reads "HHS 0 - 0 BARTLETT", the camera dives toward the pitch over a roaring crowd and pounding drums.
CUT 2: slow pan along the HHS bench; Luca #7 sits with his jaw clenched, eyes locked on the field. A coach's voice calls "Sanchez!". Tucker #11, sitting beside him, slaps his shoulder and shouts "Luca, now!".
CUT 3: Luca rises and sprints onto the pitch as a blazing blue aura flares around him; low-angle close-up as he stares down the red Bartlett defense, the crowd noise fading into a deep heartbeat. Luca says in Japanese, low and determined: 「俺に続け…この試合は必ず、俺が変えてみせる。」

acts.name: act2
acts.prompt:
CUT 1: frantic action montage — the ball clangs off the post, the Bartlett goalkeeper in a dark red goalkeeper kit makes a sharp, clean diving save, HHS players in black pressing hard; Gracen #8 with the captain armband wins the ball in midfield and looks up.
CUT 2: Gracen whips a curling cross to the edge of the box; Luca #7 controls it, feints, spins and slices past a Bartlett defender as a ghostly roaring tiger silhouette erupts behind him with orange energy streaks. Tucker, wearing #11 (not #7) and no armband, shouts from the side: "Luca, keep going!" Luca #7 wears no armband.
CUT 3: Luca shoots, the red-kitted goalkeeper stretches, the ball skims the crossbar and the crowd screams. Luca shouts in Japanese: 「ここで決める！」 and dribbles toward goal again, trails of energy fireworks behind him.

acts.name: act3
acts.prompt:
CUT 1: close-up of the scoreboard reading "EXTRA TIME 0 - 0", then sweat dripping from Luca #7's chin; deep in his own half, Gracen #8 launches a long pass high over the top.
CUT 2: Luca bursts onto the long ball like a meteor, streaks of light behind him, red Bartlett defenders converging from both sides; time slows as he sees the opening and shouts in Japanese: 「この一撃で、すべてが決まる！」
CUT 3: Luca unleashes a blazing strike into the top corner, the net bulges, a stadium announcer yells "Sanchez with the winner!", the final whistle blows and the stadium erupts; Tucker #11 and Gracen #8 leap onto Luca in celebration.
Final shot: low-angle hero shot of Luca #7 alone — curly black hair, tan skin, black jersey with the number 7, no armband — standing tall beneath the floodlights, fist raised, the crowd cheering in the background. It is Luca, not Gracen.
